selection.policy: Sort development jobs by sha256(seed + ':' + id), take first nonempty job per company until eight. Include all ordinary requirements; exclude the explicitly listed major requirements only.

reference_status: agent_authored_provisional_before_model_run; not human adjudicated, independent gold, or a held-out accuracy benchmark
scope: Eight historical public development JDs (six campus roles and two internships), one synthetic campus candidate. Reuse fixed parsed requirements to isolate matching; both strategies see the same full evidence. One model batch per job, one run, no retry and no result cache. Production default remains local.
rubric: Concrete implemented work may support a campus capability without literal keyword agreement. supported means the complete requirement is evidenced; partial means relevant facts with a remaining qualifier; needs_confirmation means insufficient evidence or ambiguous scope; unsupported needs explicit counterevidence. Multi-label references indicate genuine ambiguity and are excluded from strict-label metrics.
decision_rule: A promising pilot requires zero fully-supported predictions on strict non-supported references, at least five additional recovered strict supported requirements relative to local matching, 100% valid raw citations and output coverage, and p95 job latency at most 60000 ms. Passing is only a development signal, not authorization or sufficient independent evidence for changing the production default. Money is reported only if provider-specific prices are supplied; otherwise report tokens and latency.
